    Biography

    Jane Example is a partner in Weil Gotshal & Manges’ Corporate Department. Jane is a seasoned corporate lawyer active in all types of corporate transactions and in complex restructuring matters as well. He advises buy-out funds, public companies, board of directors, and senior managers in their most sensitive M&A transactions, joint-venture and industrial alliances. In addition, Jane has developed a widely acknowledged expertise in the handling of critical situations for shareholders, companies and their management team. Over the past years, he has been involved in the largest restructuring transactions in the French market place.
    Jane Example is a graduate of the University of Paris I - Panthéon Sorbonne and the University of Paris II, Panthéon Assas (Institut de Droit des Affaires, 1989). He also received a Tax DESS degree from the University of Paris IX Dauphine (1990). He is a member of the Paris Bar.
